description: tiktok-shop: Shop Products. GET /v1/tiktok/shop/products. A US TikTok Shop store's details (shopInfo) and its first page of products (up to 20) in the store's default order. First page only: cursor is always null, and has_more says whether the store has more. An empty page costs 0 credits. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Costs 0 credits when products is empty. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cursor.description: Not accepted: only the first page is available, so responses carry cursor null.

sort_by.description: Only top, the store's default order, is accepted.

name: tiktok_shop_products
